statement: For the arithmetic orbifold group pi1([P1-{0,1,infinity}/S3]), both the abstract rational relative completion and the continuous Q_l relative completion over the proconstant base S3 x Zhat* kill the entire geometric free group. The exact finite stages are S3 times the relative completion of G_Q over Gal(Q(mu_m)/Q), with unipotent kernel (G_{Q(mu_m)})^un; their specified inverse system gives the full proconstant completion. The negatively weighted completion of the tangentially split arithmetic pi1(U) over algebraic G_m is F^un semidirect A_l and retains the geometric factor.
manuscript_passages: Part E follow-up (3), completion relative to S3 x Zhat*; section 51.16 arithmetic extension and approximations; scans 172-174
notes: Abstract Q and continuous Q_l source categories are specified independently; no scalar-extension isomorphism is assumed. The proconstant-to-G_m character obstruction is proved using finite-stage factorization. The unipotent Galois kernels are explicitly specified as inverse systems, but their full structure is not claimed computed. All geometric Fermat subgroups have zero image in this arithmetic proconstant completion.
